program.name: Edge Control
program.subject: Endurance & control
program.blurb: Learn to fuck her on the edge: slow tempo strength and long holds that teach you to stay calm inside her.
program.about: Control is a skill, and this is how you last once you are buried in her. Everything is slow: five-second lowerings on squats, thrusts and push-ups, long holds at the hardest point, pelvic-floor holds between sets. The other day finishes with a long yin stretch where the only job is to breathe slowly while it burns. Level II slows the tempo further, Level III holds longer.
